tier_should.rationale: Innovative global time-series approach links warming to large GDP losses via extreme events and ocean temperatures; careful comparisons to local-temperature panels. If robust, offers major shift in climate-macro damages with broad interest.

tier_will.rationale: Large estimates and identification strategy will be scrutinized; potential confounding and aggregation concerns. Likely to place in top field or high-impact climate journal, short of top-five general barring exceptional robustness and author prestige.
